name: Turboism ACP
description: ACP v1 Agent and Settings windows that connect a user-installed ACP-compatible agent to the authenticated Turboism MCP server.

dependencies.reason: Requires the authenticated Turboism MCP endpoint before creating an ACP session.

permissions.reason: Registers the action that opens the Agent window.
Adds a direct Agent Settings entry to the Turboism menu so agent setup is available before an ACP connection.
Adds the Agent button immediately beside the Turboism Home toolbar entry.
Restores the selected agent, optional custom command, active durable session identifier, and user-authored initial instructions.
Persists the selected agent, optional custom command, session state, and user-authored initial instructions; agent credentials and MCP authorization are never stored.
Detects user-installed agent executables on PATH and common per-user install directories.
Starts and supervises the user-selected ACP agent executable as a subprocess, and opens explicitly requested agent sign-in terminals.
Reads the current authenticated loopback MCP endpoint through the runtime's non-persistent connection boundary.
